newsitem.title: USA: U.S. farm tractor sales up 14 pct in February. [CORRECTED 00:50 GMT 13/3]
newsitem.headline: U.S. farm tractor sales up 14 pct in February. [CORRECTED 00:50 GMT 13/3]

text.p: U.S. sales of farm tractors increased 14 percent in February to 7,741 from 6,790 a year earlier, the Equipment Manufacturers Institute reported.
Total two-wheel drive tractor sales rose 14.7 percent in the month to 7,354 from 6,410 and four-wheel drive tractors gained 14 percent to 387 from 380 (corrects both figures),
Year to date, total farm tractor sales were up 2.6 percent at 14,251 compared with 13,894 in 1996.
